description: Référentiel routier - tronçons is a dataset listed in departement41 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CD41. Référentiel routier: visualisation des routes départementales du Loir-et-Cher, par tronçons. Coverage: Loir-et-Cher. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Routes. The portal shows 2,754 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-10-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-departement41-fr-portal.
